review.assessment: This change adds `from . import limits` and an early-exit check (`if not limits.has_room(team): break`) to three files: `invites/api.py`, `invites/bulk_csv.py`, and `invites/sso.py`. The task scope requires that all four invite paths enforce the seat limit. The diff only covers three paths; I cannot see a fourth path in the repository tree from this change alone, so it is possible one remains unfixed.

findings.actual: The structural check reports exactly 3 file changes: invites/api.py, invites/bulk_csv.py, invites/sso.py. The task states there are four invite paths and this change does not show a fourth path being touched.
findings.defect: Incomplete scope — the diff fixes three invite entry points, but the task says one of four paths enforces the limit. A fourth path may remain unfixed and still allow seats_used > seat_limit.
findings.expected: All four member-adding entry points across the project have `limits.has_room(team)` enforced before any call to `team.add_member()`.
